info.name: Cybertech E-Commerce API
info.description:
End-to-end Postman collection for the Cybertech Spring Boot 4 / Java 26 e-commerce backend.

- Base path: `/api/v1/services/...`
- API version is sent via header `X-API-VERSION: 1.0` (per `spring.mvc.apiversion.use.header`).
- Default server port is `8081` (see `application.properties`).
- All requests use bearer JWTs minted by Keycloak. The collection-level pre-request script auto-refreshes the token from Keycloak's password-grant endpoint when `{{access_token}}` is empty or expired.
- Public endpoints (no token needed): `/api/v1/services/user/register`, `/api/v1/services/product/**`, `/api/v1/services/discounts/**`, `/api/v1/webhooks/**`, `/swagger-ui/**`, `/v3/api-docs/**`.
- ADMIN-only endpoints are clearly tagged in each request description.

exec: console.log("Keycloak token vars not set - skipping auth refresh");
console.log("Keycloak token fetch failed", err, res && res.text());

item.name: Auth
item.description: Anonymous registration plus an ADMIN-only synthetic-user mint.

request.description:
Public anonymous signup. Whitelisted exactly at `/api/v1/services/user/register` in `SecurityConfig.PUBLIC_URLS`. Creates a Keycloak user and a local `UserEntity` in the same transaction.

- Roles: none (public)
- Success: 201 Created with `{ id, keycloakId }`
- Errors: 400 validation, 409 if the email already exists in Keycloak.

response.name: 409 Email already exists

request.description:
Authenticated liveness ping — returns a string. Useful for verifying the JWT chain end-to-end.

- Roles: any authenticated user.
- Success: 200 OK with plain JSON string.

item.name: User
item.description: User self-service plus admin user management at `/services/admin/user`.

item.name: Get user by UUID (USER own / ADMIN any)

request.description:
Loads a user by UUID.

- Roles: USER (own profile only) or ADMIN (any).
- Success: 200 OK with `UserResponseDto`.
- Errors: 403 (BUG-IDOR-D2) if a USER requests another user's UUID, 404 if not found.

Self-service profile patch (Frontend-gap #3). Only firstName/lastName/phoneNumber/address are mutable here — email, role and status are Keycloak/admin-owned and off-limits by design (see UserSelfUpdateRequestDto). Caller identity is resolved from the JWT subject, not the body.

- Roles: USER or ADMIN
- Success: 200 with the refreshed `UserResponseDto`.

Paginated user listing. ADMIN only (controller-level `@PreAuthorize`).

- Role: ADMIN
- Success: 200 OK with Spring Data `Page<UserResponseDto>`.
- Errors: 403 if caller is not ADMIN.

ADMIN-side user creation. Useful when on-boarding internal users without going through the public `/register` flow.

- Role: ADMIN
- Success: 201 with `UserResponseDto`.

PATCH user fields. Only the fields supplied are updated.

- Role: ADMIN
- Success: 200 with the refreshed `UserResponseDto`.

Hard-delete a user (Keycloak + DB).

- Role: ADMIN
- Success: 204 No Content.

Developer / load-test utility — mints one synthetic user via `DataGenerator`. Moved from the user-facing controller onto `UserManagementAdminController` (admin-split refactor).

- Role: ADMIN
- Success: 201 with `{ id, keycloakId, email, username }`
- Errors: 403 if caller is not ADMIN.

item.name: Product
item.description: Public product catalog reads + ADMIN management writes.

request.description:
Public product details. Whitelisted under `/api/v1/services/product/**`.

- Roles: none (public).
- Success: 200 with `ProductResponseDto`.
- Errors: 404 if unknown UUID.

Elasticsearch-backed product search with faceting.

- Roles: none (public).
- Success: 200 with `Page<ProductResponseDto>`.

Returns the best-selling products by sales count.

- Roles: none (public).
- Success: 200 with `Page<ProductResponseDto>`.

Admin: list every product (including soft-archived).

- Role: ADMIN
- Success: 200 with `Page<ProductResponseDto>`.

request.description:
PATCH product. Path UUID and body UUID must match (the controller throws `IllegalArgumentException` otherwise).

- Role: ADMIN
- Success: 200 with `ProductResponseDto`.
- Errors: 400 if UUIDs mismatch.

Delete a product.

- Role: ADMIN
- Success: 204 No Content.

Multipart: JSON `product` part + `image` file part. Image is uploaded to S3 and the resulting URL is set on the product.

- Role: ADMIN
- Success: 201 with `ProductResponseDto`.

item.name: Cart
item.description: User-owned cart. JWT subject identifies the cart owner.

request.description:
Loads the current user's cart based on the JWT subject.

- Roles: USER or ADMIN
- Success: 200 with `CartResponseDto`.

BUG-161 — ownership-checked. Forwards JWT subject so the service rejects IDOR attempts.

- Roles: USER or ADMIN
- Success: 200 with `CartResponseDto`.
- Errors: 403 if cart belongs to a different user, 404 if not found.

Bulk-initialise a cart with items.

- Roles: USER or ADMIN
- Success: 201 with `CartResponseDto`.

Append items to the caller's existing cart.

- Roles: USER or ADMIN
- Success: 201 with refreshed `CartResponseDto`.

BUG-026/BUG-161 — replace the cart's item list. Ownership-checked.

- Roles: USER or ADMIN
- Success: 200 with `CartResponseDto`.
- Errors: 403 IDOR, 404 cart not found.

Remove a single product entirely from the caller's cart.

- Roles: USER or ADMIN
- Success: 200 with refreshed `CartResponseDto`.

Decrease a line-item's quantity by `quantity`. If the line drops to zero, the product is removed.

- Roles: USER or ADMIN
- Success: 200 with `CartResponseDto`.

Empty all items from the caller's cart.

- Roles: USER or ADMIN
- Success: 204 No Content.

Hard-delete a cart by UUID. Ownership-checked (BUG-161).

- Roles: USER or ADMIN
- Success: 204 No Content.
- Errors: 403 IDOR, 404 not found.

item.name: Order
item.description: Order placement, cancellation, payment retry, and admin deletion.

request.description:
Place an order from the user's existing cart. Identity comes from the JWT subject (no `userUuid` accepted).

- Roles: USER or ADMIN
- Success: 201 with `OrderResponseDto`.
- Errors: 400 empty cart, 402 payment failure, 409 stock conflict.

Cancel a pending order; refunds Stripe payment if it was captured.

- Roles: USER (own only) or ADMIN
- Success: 200 with refreshed `OrderResponseDto`.
- Errors: 403 not the owner, 409 if already shipped.

Update shipping options or items on a pending order.

- Roles: USER (own) or ADMIN
- Success: 200 with updated `OrderResponseDto`.

Re-creates the Stripe PaymentIntent for an order that previously failed payment.

- Roles: USER (own) or ADMIN
- Success: 200 with `OrderResponseDto` containing a fresh `clientSecret`.

BUG-IDOR-D4 — debug/load helper. Builds a synthetic order via `DataGenerator.orderGenerator()`. Lives on `OrderManagementAdminController` (admin-split refactor).

- Role: ADMIN
- Success: 201 with `OrderResponseDto`.

item.name: Get order by UUID (USER own / ADMIN any)

request.description:
BUG-IDOR-D1 — ownership-checked at the service layer.

- Roles: USER (own) or ADMIN
- Success: 200 with `OrderResponseDto`.
- Errors: 403 if order belongs to a different user.

Lightweight status read used by the order-confirmation poller.

- Roles: USER (own) or ADMIN
- Success: 200 with `OrderStatusDto { status }`.

item.name: Get my orders (paged, optional status filter)

request.description:
Frontend-gap #1 — paginated listing of the caller's own orders. Optional repeatable `status` query param filters by OrderStatus (CREATED, AWAITING_PAYMENT, PAID, SHIPPED, DELIVERED, CANCELED...) — omit for all statuses.

- Roles: USER or ADMIN
- Success: 200 OK with Spring Data `Page<OrderResponseDto>`.

Hard-delete an order. Lives on `OrderManagementAdminController` (admin-split refactor).

- Role: ADMIN
- Success: 204 No Content.

Frontend-gap #2 — admin-side paginated order listing across every user, with optional `status` (repeatable OrderStatus) and `userKeycloakId` filters.

- Role: ADMIN (controller-level `@PreAuthorize`)
- Success: 200 OK with Spring Data `Page<OrderResponseDto>`.

item.name: Review
item.description: Product reviews tied to past purchases.

request.description:
Authenticated read of a single review.

- Roles: any authenticated user.
- Success: 200 with `ReviewResponseDto`.

Post a 1-5 review against a product the user actually purchased (`order` must exist and be PAID/SHIPPED/DELIVERED). Identity is taken from the JWT.

- Role: USER
- Success: 201 with `ReviewResponseDto`.
- Errors: 403 not the order owner, 409 review already exists.

Edit your own review.

- Role: USER (must be the author)
- Success: 200 with refreshed `ReviewResponseDto`.
- Errors: 403 not author.

Delete your own review.

- Role: USER (author only)
- Success: 204 No Content.

Products the caller bought (orders in PAID / SHIPPED / DELIVERED) but has not yet reviewed; each entry carries the `orderUuid` to forward to `POST /create`.

- Role: USER
- Success: 200 with `List<ReviewableProductDto>`.

item.name: Bank Card
item.description: User-owned default card plus admin CRUD over all cards.

request.description:
Add a bank card to the caller's profile. Card number is encrypted at rest, only the last 4 are kept in plaintext.

- Roles: USER or ADMIN
- Success: 201 with masked `BankCardResponseDto`.

Replace the caller's existing card details.

- Roles: USER or ADMIN
- Success: 200 with masked `BankCardResponseDto`.

Delete the caller's bank card.

- Roles: USER or ADMIN
- Success: 204 No Content.

Mark the supplied card as the caller's default. Sibling cards are demoted in the same transaction.

- Roles: USER or ADMIN
- Success: 204 No Content.

Return the caller's default card (masked).

- Roles: USER or ADMIN
- Success: 200 with `BankCardResponseDto`.

Frontend-gap #4 — lists every bank card owned by the caller. Returns at most one today (one-card-per-user, `@OneToOne UserEntity.bankCardEntity`); kept as a list for forward-compatibility.

- Roles: USER or ADMIN
- Success: 200 with `List<BankCardResponseDto>`.

Admin paged listing of every card. Lives on `BankCardAdminController` (admin-split refactor).

- Role: ADMIN
- Success: 200 with `Page<BankCardResponseDto>`.

ADMIN-only fetch of any card by UUID. Lives on `BankCardAdminController` (admin-split refactor).

- Role: ADMIN
- Success: 200 with `BankCardResponseDto`.

ADMIN: create a card directly on a user UUID. Lives on `BankCardAdminController` (admin-split refactor).

- Role: ADMIN
- Success: 201 with `BankCardResponseDto`.

ADMIN: edit any card. Lives on `BankCardAdminController` — method changed PUT→PATCH in the admin-split refactor.

- Role: ADMIN
- Success: 200 with `BankCardResponseDto`.

ADMIN: hard-delete a card. Lives on `BankCardAdminController` (admin-split refactor).

- Role: ADMIN
- Success: 204 No Content.

Add a product to the caller's wishlist.

- Roles: any authenticated user.
- Success: 201 with `WishlistResponseDto`.

Remove a product from the caller's wishlist.

- Roles: any authenticated user.
- Success: 204 No Content.

Returns the caller's wishlist as a Spring Data `Page`.

- Roles: any authenticated user.
- Success: 200 with `Page<WishlistResponseDto>`.

item.name: Discount
item.description: Public read of currently-active campaigns + admin PATCH to tune them.

request.description:
Public list of every campaign that is `enabled=true` AND inside its `[startsAt, endsAt]` window. Whitelisted under `/api/v1/services/discounts/**`.

- Roles: none (public).
- Success: 200 with `List<DiscountContext>`.

ADMIN: list every campaign regardless of state.

- Role: ADMIN
- Success: 200 with `List<DiscountCampaignResponseDto>`.

ADMIN: load one campaign. Allowed values: `BUY_ONE_GET_ONE_FREE`, `BLACK_FRIDAY`, `WINTER_SALES`, `SPRING_SALES`, `NO_DISCOUNT`.

- Role: ADMIN
- Success: 200.

ADMIN: PATCH a campaign. All fields are optional — null means "do not change". Cache flushes after a successful write so the next price calculation picks up the new state.

- Role: ADMIN
- Success: 200 with refreshed `DiscountCampaignResponseDto`.

Persist a behavioural event in MongoDB. The server overwrites any client-supplied `userId` with the JWT subject (BUG-SPOOF-D5).

- Role: USER
- Success: 201 with the persisted `UserEvent` document.
- Allowed `eventType` values: PURCHASE, ADD_TO_CART, WISHLIST_ADD, RATING_POSITIVE, RATING_NEGATIVE, REVIEW_POSITIVE, REVIEW_NEGATIVE, VIEW, CLICK, SCROLL_DEPTH_HIGH, HOVER, SEARCH_QUERY, SEARCH_RESULT_CLICK, REMOVE_FROM_CART, IGNORE_RECOMMENDATION, BOUNCE.

item.name: Webhook
item.description: Stripe webhook ingestion. Public, signature-verified — for Stripe to call, not humans.

request.description:
Stripe-only endpoint. Use the Stripe CLI (`stripe listen --forward-to ...`) to deliver real signed events; this Postman entry is for documentation only — calling it directly will return 400 because the `Stripe-Signature` header is fake.

- Roles: none (public, signature-verified).
- Success: 200 OK (Stripe is informed not to retry).
- Errors: 400 if signature is invalid or payload is malformed JSON.
